prev_agent: Here's what I built: **New file: `user-menu.tsx`** — A `UserMenu` component using Radix `@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu` (same accessible primitives underlying shadcn). Shows: - **Trigger**: An avatar button with user initials in the sidebar footer (bottom-left) - **Dropdown** (opens upward from the trigger): - Profile icon + user email (label) - Settings button (navigates to `#/settings`) - Log out button (calls `lightfastBridge.auth.signOut()`) **Changes:** - `index.html` — Added `.sidebar-footer` with `#user-menu-root` mount point after the nav - `entry.tsx` — Extracted a shared `Providers` wrapper, mounts `UserMenu` into the sidebar as a second React root - `app-shell.tsx` — Removed the inline sign-out button and `AccountCard` (now handled by the sidebar menu) - `styles.css` — Added CSS for the sidebar footer, trigger button, dropdown content, items, and animations, all using the existing desktop design tokens - `vite.renderer.config.ts` — Added `@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu` and `lucide-react` to `optimizeDeps` The dropdown has full keyboard navigation, focus management, and dismiss-on-click-outside — all from Radix. The `UserMenu` only renders when signed in since the sidebar is hidden behind `data-kind-primary` and the `SignedOutShell` overlay covers everything when signed out.
